'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Eleven members of [[La Familia Michoacana]] and three civilians are killed and seven injured during a shootout between criminals and civilian farmers from Texcapilla, municipality of [[Texcaltitlán]], Mexico. The attack took place in a soccer camp while the criminals threatened civilians if they didn't pay tribute.[https://apnews.com/article/mexico-farming-town-11-dead-drug-cartel-c38c846aa25052dee1e21c2c8e9d1660 (AP)][https://politica.expansion.mx/estados/2023/12/11/enfrentamiento-en-texcaltitlan-el-payaso-que-se-sabe (Política Expansión)]

*[[2023 Sri Lankan blackouts]]
**A nationwide [[power outage]] occurs in [[Sri Lanka]] due to a system failure. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nationwide-power-outage-sri-lanka-due-system-failure-government-official-2023-12-09/ (Reuters)]
*A series of [[tornado|tornadoes]] hits [[Tennessee]], [[United States]], killing six people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/tennessee-looks-recovery-after-string-deadly-tornadoes-2023-12-10/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''

**The [[United Nations Security Council]] holds a closed-door meeting on the ongoing crisis between [[Venezuela]] and [[Guyana]] over the [[Guayana Esequiba]] region, but takes no immediate action. '''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 NBA season]]

***In [[basketball]], the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] win the inaugural [[NBA In-Season Tournament]] after defeating the [[Indiana Pacers]] 123–109 in the championship game.
